title: Hoosiers handle Tide, book rematch with Ducks
summary: Fernando Mendoza, this season's Heisman Trophy winner, led the Hoosiers to a comfortable win over Alabama on Thursday at the Rose Bowl as Indiana secured a spot in the CFP semifinals against Oregon.
contentText: Indiana quarterback Fernando Mendoza and the top-seeded Hoosiers won the Rose Bowl Thursday in convincing fashion, authoring a 38-3 victory over No. 9 Alabama to secure a berth in the College Football Playoff semifinals, where they will meet No. 5 Oregon.
